retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait featuring a central subject with dynamic posing, anchored by a large-scale expressive script overlay and a high-contrast teal-to-white background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A female subject in early 2000s fashion sits on a bright white ledge against a teal gradient background, with a massive, fluid orange script nameplate spanning the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between the loops of the script
Orange lettering contrasting against the teal background
White ledge providing a horizontal anchor for the vertical subject
Hair movement echoing the fluid lines of the typography
coreInvariants: Teal and orange complementary color scheme

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, full-body seated pose, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white horizontal ledge in the lower third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the hair down to the large script, and sweep across the horizontal nameplate.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper teal corners to allow the subject's hair to flow.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange text against a desaturated, cool-toned background.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a broad-nib marker
Interconnected glyphs with a hand-drawn feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter is oversized and acts as a frame
Terminal strokes extend horizontally to fill the width of the composition

composition.overlap: foreground, partially obscuring the subject's legs

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone expressive script; no secondary typeface used.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, non-mechanical nature of the original lettering
Captures the casual, energetic vibe of early 2000s urban aesthetics

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a subject in early 2000s fashion, seated on a bright white ledge against a teal gradient background with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, vibrant orange custom script nameplate across the center of the image, ensuring the letters overlap the subject's legs.

verificationChecks: Is the orange script the most prominent graphic element?
Does the teal background have a smooth gradient?
Is the subject's pose dynamic and centered?
Is the white ledge perfectly horizontal?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange script is not obscured by the background.
Verify the white ledge is bright and clean.
Ensure the subject's face is the focal point despite the large text.
Confirm the teal gradient is smooth without banding.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Teal Gradient + White Ledge Anchor + Massive Orange Script Overlay
